title: PACE%2BCode%2BD%2B2023.pdf — section 51
text:
4.17 PACE, section 61A, provides power for a police officer to take footwear impressions without
consent from any person over the age of ten years who is detained at a police station:
(a) in consequence of being arrested for a recordable offence, see Note 4A ; or if the
detainee has been charged with a recordable offence, or informed they will be reported
for such an offence; and
(b) the detainee has not had an impression of their footwear taken in the course of the
investigation of the offence unless the previously taken impression is not complete or is
not of sufficient quality to allow satisfactory analysis, comparison or matching (whether
in the case in question or generally).

4.18 Reasonable force may be used, if necessary, to take a footwear impression from a detainee
without consent under the power in paragraph 4.17.
